guide.summary: Art spaces, a children's museum, a film venue, sweets, coffee and hotel dining in Amman, checked against their own websites.
highlights: Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts
guide.tip: Plan around closing days: the Children's Museum Jordan is closed on Tuesdays, the Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts on Fridays and official holidays, Darat al Funun opens Saturday to Thursday and closes in August and on public holidays, and Toscana at the Sheraton Amman Al Nabil is closed on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Children's Museum Jordan is closed on Tuesdays, the Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts on Fridays and official holidays, and Darat al Funun opens Saturday to Thursday and closes in August and on public holidays. Toscana at the Sheraton Amman Al Nabil is closed on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Children's Museum Jordan tickets are sold through its online portal, at JD 5 per non-resident family member, with children under one free. Zenith at The St. Regis Amman takes reservations online or on +962 6-4000500, and Shams El Balad and Fakhreldin Restaurant take bookings through their websites.

toolkit.label: Breakfast access
toolkit.copy: The Mercado breakfast buffet at The St. Regis Amman is for in-house guests only, while the hotel's Tea Lounge opens daily from 8:00 AM. The Spice Garden at the Sheraton Amman Al Nabil lists breakfast from 6:30 AM every day.

toolkit.label: Dress and age rules
toolkit.copy: The St. Regis Bar, Zenith and Tamara at The St. Regis Amman list a smart casual dress code, as do Roberto's and Kenz at The Ritz-Carlton, Amman. At the Children's Museum Jordan, children must be accompanied by a parent or an authorised adult at all times.

guide.dek: Check each venue's closing day before you set out, because Amman's museums and galleries close on different days of the week.
intro: You can build a day in Amman around Jabal al Weibdeh's art spaces. Darat al Funun, at 13 Nadeem al Mallah Street, opens Saturday to Thursday from 10am to 7pm and closes in August and on public holidays; its exhibition A Geography For Return opened on Tuesday 17 November 2026. The Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts in Al-Luwaibdeh opens from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM every day except Fridays and is closed on official holidays. Its park is open from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM and its café and restaurant from 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

With children, the Children's Museum Jordan on King Abdullah II Street is closed on Tuesdays. From 1 September to 31 May it opens Sunday to Wednesday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and Thursday to Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.; from 1 June to 31 August it opens daily from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Tickets are sold online, non-resident family members pay JD 5 each, children under one enter free, and children must stay with a parent or authorised adult. Abdali Mall on Al Istithmar Street opens 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and 12:00 PM to 11:30 PM on Fridays.

For food, Shams El Balad at 69 Mu'ath Bin Jabal Street takes reservations through its website. Fakhreldin Restaurant on Taha Hussein Street in Jabal Amman also takes online bookings, and its website (dated 2025) lists daily hours of 1 pm to 12 am. Habibah Sweets has a Downtown branch on King Hussein Street and opened a branch at Abdoun Village in 2026. Dimitri's Coffee lists branches in Lweibdeh on Al-Baouneyah Street, in Sweifieh Village and at Abdali Boulevard, but does not publish branch opening hours. The Royal Film Commission, off Rainbow Street, runs a programme of film days and screenings.

Hotel venues publish clearer hours. At The St. Regis Amman, the St. Regis Bar opens daily from 12:00 PM to 1:30 AM and the rooftop Zenith from 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM, both with a smart casual dress code, and you can reserve Zenith online or by phone. The Fairmont Amman lists daily happy hours at Caprice Groovy Room from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM and at Nasim Rooftop Lounge from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM, plus afternoon tea at Crystal Lounge from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM. At the Sheraton Amman Al Nabil, Toscana is closed on Mondays.
summaryCards: Start in Jabal al Weibdeh at Darat al Funun, open Saturday to Thursday from 10am to 7pm, and the Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts, which is closed on Fridays and official holidays, then book dinner at Fakhreldin Restaurant or Shams El Balad.
Have breakfast at The Spice Garden in the Sheraton Amman Al Nabil, which opens at 6:30 AM, or coffee at Dimitri's Coffee in Lweibdeh, then pick up sweets at Habibah Sweets on King Hussein Street.

Check closing days: the Children's Museum Jordan is closed on Tuesdays, the Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts on Fridays and official holidays, Darat al Funun on Fridays, in August and on public holidays, and Toscana on Mondays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Citadel, Roman Theater and Jerash could not be confirmed: the Department of Antiquities and Ministry of Tourism sites refused connection, and the Jordan Pass hours page is dated 2022 with no address. The Jordan Museum's site is being redeveloped. The Royal Automobile Museum, Royal Tank Museum, Four Seasons, W Amman, Grand Hyatt, Le Royal, Books@Cafe, Mijana, Al Balad Theater and Nabad Gallery could not be read (connection, DNS, SSL or 403/423 errors). Opening hours are not published for Habibah Sweets, Shams El Balad, Dimitri's Coffee branches, Bar on Four, Threesixty or the Royal Film Commission; Fairmont venues show only promotion times. Fakhreldin's hours come from a page dated 2025, and The Ritz-Carlton, Amman dining page carries no date. Habibah Sweets branches are named by street only, without building numbers.
